GD-AUTOHEAT.Reconciliation: Knowledge-graph implementation paths are authoritative for runtime modules; development-plan contracts, layer/order facts, phases, and data flows are merged where they add detail.

M-MAIN.Name: AppEntry
M-MAIN.Summary: Flutter entry point; bootstraps DI, theme, accessibility, background service, and the root application.

M-DI.Name: ServiceLocator
M-DI.Summary: Registers SharedPreferences, services, and Cubits in GetIt with idempotent guards per isolate.

M-BLOC-PROVIDERS.Name: AppBlocProviders
M-BLOC-PROVIDERS.Summary: Builds the BlocProvider list for the root MultiBlocProvider.

M-PLUGIN.Name: AndroidAutomotivePlugin
M-PLUGIN.Summary: Local path bridge over android.car HVAC, sensors, and ignition; awaited native connect/read/write failures propagate to Dart.
M-PLUGIN.Notes: Local snapshot of abuharsky/changan_car_flutter_library; no plugin test directory exists in the legacy state.

M-HVAC.Name: HvacService
M-HVAC.Summary: Central HVAC wrapper with lazy initialization, seat commands, cached cabin temperature, multi-listener events, native value parsing, and raw -1 filtering.

M-AUTO-HEAT.Name: AutoHeatService
M-AUTO-HEAT.Summary: Automatic heating scheduler driven by cabin temperature and optional ManualHeatSettings; levels descend 3 to 2 to 1 to 0 independently per user.

M-MODE.Name: ModeDomain
M-MODE.Summary: Manual, presets, and automatic mode state plus per-user heat level and selected preset persistence; routes commands to HVAC and AutoHeatService.

M-CABIN-TEMPERATURE.Name: CabinTemperatureDomain
M-CABIN-TEMPERATURE.Summary: UI state projection of cabin temperature with initial read, cached emit, and independent listener updates.

M-PRESET.Name: PresetDomain
M-PRESET.Summary: Persists preset configurations and selected preset IDs per user and applies them to runtime heating.

M-SETTINGS.Name: SettingsDomain
M-SETTINGS.Summary: Persists global settings such as the automatic-mode temperature threshold and exposes them through SettingsCubit.

M-THEME.Name: ThemeDomain
M-THEME.Summary: Persists and applies the selected visual theme through ThemeCubit and ThemeConfigurator.

M-BACKGROUND.Name: BackgroundService
M-BACKGROUND.Summary: Foreground service that initializes the plugin and ModeCubit in a background isolate and reacts to ignition and HVAC events.

M-ACCESSIBILITY.Name: AccessibilityService
M-ACCESSIBILITY.Summary: Registers the system callback handle through AndroidAutomotivePlugin to wake the foreground service.

M-LOGGER.Name: Logger
M-LOGGER.Summary: Structured print-based logging with module/function/block markers, fields, redaction, ring buffer, and test sink.

M-CONSTANTS-TEMPERATURE.Name: TemperatureConstants
M-CONSTANTS-TEMPERATURE.Summary: Temperature ranges, default threshold, slider values, and HeatSequence durations for automatic heating.

M-ENUMS.Name: AppEnums
M-ENUMS.Summary: Stable HeatMode and UserType enums with string deserialization extensions.
M-ENUMS.Notes: Enum names are persisted and cannot change without a data migration.

M-UI-APP.Name: UiAppShell
M-UI-APP.Summary: Root AppContent shell and navigation between Heat, Presets, and Settings screens.

M-UI-HEAT.Name: HeatScreen
M-UI-HEAT.Summary: Main heating-control screen with seat controls, cabin-temperature display, and mode switcher.

M-UI-PRESETS.Name: PresetsTab
M-UI-PRESETS.Summary: Combined preset tab with driver/passenger selector, editor, list, apply, edit, delete, and new-preset actions.

M-UI-SETTINGS.Name: SettingsScreen
M-UI-SETTINGS.Summary: Slim global-settings screen for theme selection and cabin-temperature visibility.

DF-SET-HEAT.Name: UserSetsHeatLevel
DF-SET-HEAT.Step-1: HeatScreen calls ModeCubit.setHeatLevel for the selected user.
DF-SET-HEAT.Step-2: ModeCubit persists level and mode through ModeService.
DF-SET-HEAT.Step-4: HvacService delegates to CarHvacManager and AndroidAutomotivePlugin.
DF-SET-HEAT.Step-5: ModeCubit emits ModesState and the UI rebuilds.

DF-AUTO-HEAT.Name: AutoHeatBySensor
DF-AUTO-HEAT.Step-3: HvacService filters property and area, converts raw value, caches it, and publishes listeners.
DF-AUTO-HEAT.Step-4: AutoHeatService builds a user-specific HeatSequence with ManualHeatSettings or fallback constants.
DF-AUTO-HEAT.Step-5: AutoHeatService cancels the prior effective plan and schedules levels 3, 2, 1, 0.
DF-AUTO-HEAT.Step-6: ModeCubit applies callback levels and continues through DF-SET-HEAT.
DF-AUTO-HEAT.Evidence: AutoHeatService startHeatSequence marker and ordered ModeState changes.

DF-INIT-TEMP.Name: InitialCabinTemperature
DF-INIT-TEMP.Trigger: App start and deferred HvacService initialization
DF-INIT-TEMP.Step-2: HvacService connects and reads the native inside-temperature property.
DF-INIT-TEMP.Step-3: HvacService converts the value, caches it, and publishes listeners; failures use the documented fallback.
DF-INIT-TEMP.Evidence: Initial value reaches automatic scheduling and CabinTemperatureDisplay.

DF-BACKGROUND.Name: ForegroundServiceLifecycle
DF-BACKGROUND.Trigger: App launch, boot, or accessibility wake
DF-BACKGROUND.Step-1: main.dart configures AndroidConfiguration and starts the foreground service.
DF-BACKGROUND.Step-2: background onStart initializes plugins, DI, HVAC, sensors, and ignition subscriptions.
DF-BACKGROUND.Step-3: Ignition events update heating state; ignition OFF awaits service stop and seat shutdown.
DF-BACKGROUND.Evidence: Foreground notification, BackgroundService onStart marker, and bounded restart attempts.

DF-PRESET-APPLY.Name: ApplyPreset
DF-PRESET-APPLY.Step-1: PresetsTab selects a preset and its settings for the active user.
DF-PRESET-APPLY.Step-2: Preset and selected identity are persisted per UserType.
DF-PRESET-APPLY.Step-3: ModeCubit enters presets mode and applies HvacService.setSeatHeatLevel.
DF-PRESET-APPLY.Evidence: ModeCubit applyPreset marker, HvacService marker, and selected preset state.

HistoricalPlan.CompletedPhases: Foundation; reliability hardening; functional hardening; UX redesign; mode-source decoupling.
HistoricalPlan.DeferredTriggers: In-app diagnostics; empirical temperature conversion validation; model-specific temperature profile.
HistoricalPlan.ExecutionPolicy: Controller owns shared artifacts; workers own module-local runtime and tests; maximum two fix attempts per step; checkpoints record preferences, HVAC properties, subscriptions, and isolate.
